title: The keyframe-anything and keys-copy-between-layers walks pass again
goal: Two walks that check keys fail on the current code, so the loop's checks report keys as broken and nobody can tell a real key regression from these. They need updating to what the app does now, or the app needs fixing where it is the one that is wrong.
notes:
Reproduced 2026-10-13 on HEAD 506bc8b9 with the every-key-dot task's changes stashed (git stash, Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/<walk>.json, probe in the background, screen unlocked):
- keyframe-anything-walk: "step 64 (expect): no menu called \"Easing\" is in the panel to read; the ones that are: Properties Menu, Curve, Fade In, Fade Out, Style, ..." (the panel row is now Curve under Between the keys).
- keys-copy-between-layers-walk: "step 63 (expect): the control called \"Key\" in \"Scale\" reads \"Scale, on a key\", not \"between keys\"". No setup front, so this is not the probe-cannot-take-the-front problem.
Same errors with the every-key-dot changes in place. The 2026-10-13 value-graph task's log also saw keys-copy-between-layers-walk fail that day.
acceptance: keyframe-anything-walk passes at Next defaults, with its step that read the panel's Easing menu changed to whatever now holds the ease (or the menu restored, if its removal was a mistake)

keys-copy-between-layers-walk passes: either the pasted keys land where the walk expects (Scale reads between keys at its step 63), or the walk is corrected with a note on why the landing moment changed
Both walks named on this task with queue.mjs walks

Reproduced on HEAD 67b0fa68: keyframe-anything-walk already passes (its Easing step reads the timeline bar's Easing menu, which is back); keys-copy-between-layers-walk passed its old step 63 and failed at step 96: dragging the middle volume point down left all three at 0.0 dB. Cause (app, not walk): since 44d69b6e a level point's DragGesture is attached before .position, so it read the hand in the 11pt dot's own space. Fixed by reading it in the line's named space; the picked segment's bend handle had the same fault and the same fix. Found the same class of bug on the value graph's key handles (KeyLanesView handleGesture): reproduced with a scratch walk, the handle snapped back onto its key; after a first fix it went only half way, because the handle's own space moves with it. Now read as start + translation in the lanes' fixed space; lands exactly under the pointer (560,905). New walks a-sound-s-bend-handle-follows-the-hand-walk and a-graph-handle-follows-the-hand-walk prove both at defaults with a real pointer drag.

Both walks pass at Next defaults on fe49ef7f. keyframe-anything-walk already passed on HEAD (no change needed). keys-copy-between-layers-walk was failing on a real app bug: a volume point's drag read the pointer in the dot's own box, so dragging a point did nothing; fixed in SoundLane.swift, along with the bend handle (same fault). Same class of bug found and reproduced on the value graph's key handles (snapped back to the key), fixed in KeyLanesView.swift to land exactly under the pointer. New walks a-sound-s-bend-handle-follows-the-hand-walk and a-graph-handle-follows-the-hand-walk prove both with real pointer drags; value-graph, volume-line, fade-diamond and key walks all pass; Scripts/test.sh green (13101 tests).
